instructions:
## Task

Use data on the locations and related information of fatal car crashes in New York City, along with the GeoJSON data of NYC administrative regions, plot the geographical distribution of fatal crashes in 2016 on a map. Save the figure as 'pred_results/collisions_map_vis.png'.

## Optional expert knowledge

geoplot is a high-level Python geospatial plotting library. It’s an extension to cartopy and matplotlib. The geoplot.pointplot() is a geospatial scatter plot function that plots each observation in your dataset as a single point on a map. 

## Input files

```text
|-- nyc_collisions_map/
|---- fatal_collisions.geojson
|---- nyc_boroughs.geojson
```

## Submission and evaluator

Write a self-contained Python program that creates `pred_results/collisions_map_vis.png`. Evaluation script: `eval_plot_collisions_map.py`.
